name: gadyuka-backend
description: ГАДЮКА backend: content, media, leads and admin API for the site
author: https://t.me/stansful

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run prisma:prepare && npm run type:check:prod
scripts.prepare: command -v husky >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm run husky:prepare || true
scripts.start:dev: npm run prisma:prepare && npm run prisma:deploy && npm run clean && npm run type:check && nest start --watch -e 'node --env-file=./.env'
scripts.start:prod: npm run prisma:prepare && npm run prisma:deploy && npm run clean && npm run type:check:prod && node --env-file-if-exists=./.env ./dist/backend/src/main.js
scripts.start:test: npm run prisma:prepare && npm run prisma:deploy && npm run clean && npm run type:check && node --env-file-if-exists=./.env ./dist/backend/src/main.js
scripts.start:uat: npm run prisma:prepare && npm run prisma:deploy && npm run clean && npm run type:check:prod && node --env-file-if-exists=./.env ./dist/backend/src/main.js
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run type:check && npm run prisma:deploy:test && node --env-file-if-exists=./.env --env-file-if-exists=./.env.test --test './dist/**/!(*.e2e).test.js' && node --env-file-if-exists=./.env --env-file-if-exists=./.env.test --test --test-concurrency=1 './dist/**/*.e2e.test.js'
scripts.test:e2e: npm run clean && npm run type:check && npm run prisma:deploy:test && node --env-file-if-exists=./.env --env-file-if-exists=./.env.test --test --test-concurrency=1 './dist/**/*.e2e.test.js'
scripts.test:unit: npm run clean && npm run type:check && node --test './dist/**/!(*.e2e).test.js'
